content.value: Water flows under a sluice on a horizontal bed at the inlet to a flume. Upstream from the gate, (I 0) the water depth is 45cm and the speed is negligible. At the vcna-contracta downstream from the gate, the flow streamlines arc straight and the depth is 5cm. Determine the flow speed downstream from the gate and the discharge. Assume the width of the gate is 15cm.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
